From: Emma Turner <emma.turner@cedarhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP request + timeline constraints (Q3 pilot)

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the demo last week. The exec team at CedarHealth is interested in a tightly scoped pilot to evaluate inference latency and data handling for PHI-adjacent workflows. Finance and security asked for a mutual action plan (MAP) that includes measurable milestones and a suggested close/timeline so procurement can budget the Q3 window.

I attached the RFP summary from our side — you'll see the key success criteria and constrained dates. Can you share a Redwood MAP template and a short slide deck we can present to the stakeholder committee? Ideally a single-sheet MAP and a 3-slide kickoff deck.

Target timeline from our side: pilot start no earlier than 2025-07-14, 4–6 week evaluation, final decision by 2025-09-01.

Best,
Emma Turner
Senior PM, Clinical Automation
CedarHealth
emma.turner@cedarhealth.com
attachment: RFP_Q3_Pilot.pdf (1 page)

Subject: Re: Pilot MAP request + timeline constraints (Q3 pilot)

Hi Emma —

Appreciate the clear timeline. Attached are two stubs we usually start with: a one‑page MAP template (editable GDoc) and a 3‑slide kickoff deck (GSlides) that maps milestones to owners and acceptance criteria. I also added a short first-draft timeline that aligns with your earliest start date (week of 2025-07-14).

High-level proposed MAP milestones:
- Week 0 (kickoff): align success metrics, access & sample data scope
- Week 1–2: baseline performance & data ingest verification
- Week 3–4: feature testing & edge-case evaluation (latency/throughput)
- Week 5: security review checklist + SOC evidence handoff
- Week 6: joint readout + ops transition recommendation

Next steps I propose:
1) We co-edit the GDoc MAP template this week — I invited Marissa (CS) and Rishi (solutions) to add implementation tasks and acceptance gates.
2) Schedule a 45‑minute kickoff workshop during the week of 2025-07-07 for stakeholder alignment (prep materials in the attached slides).
3) Share final MAP with procurement by 2025-07-10 to lock the pilot start.

Links/attachments:
- MAP (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C4MAP_TEMPLATE
- Kickoff slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XyZ_PILOT_SLIDES
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876543210/RDW-2347

I pasted a lightweight MAP table in the doc for quick editing. Let me know if you'd like me to prefill acceptance criteria based on the RFP.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jasmine — added a couple of practical items to the MAP doc:
- Data ingestion checklist (sample sizes, masking strategy, and retention TTL during the pilot)
- Suggested acceptance thresholds: 99th pctl latency < 450ms on 95% of target requests; offline regression < 10% QA failure rate
- A short security evidence list we can produce (SOC2 excerpts, audit log sampling, KMS integration note)

Emma — I flagged two potential schedule pinch points: 1) SOC review slot (we can compress to 1 week if CedarHealth can accept redacted logs rather than full samples) and 2) onboarding access (service account + VPC peering) which typically needs 3–5 business days. If you can confirm contacts for infra and security on your side, I can pre-seed the tasks and owners in the MAP.

I also uploaded a 1‑page acceptance checklist into the slides deck (slide 2).

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
